verdict.rationale: A skill is documented as a plain directory containing a `SKILL.md` plus optional scripts and references. A real install landed those as ordinary files under `.agents/skills/`, so every file can be read after installing. Before installing, a lead can inspect the public curated catalog, which lists source paths, and the GitHub source directories that `$skill-installer` installs from, but there is no documented install-time preview or contents listing. Missing for 10: a native pre-install contents/diff preview in `$skill-installer` or `/plugins`, an explicit listing of the scripts a plugin will add, and hands-on corroboration of the review workflow inside Codex itself.
